name: piezo
title: Bare piezo disc

ways.do: one leg to its GPIO, the other to ground
the legs to two GPIOs of its own, in antiphase: one LEDC timer, hpoint of the second channel half a period

notes: Each disc has its own LEDC channels and lines, as on the bench: a louder sound takes two lines for a disc, not more discs on one line.
Glued by its whole area to a wall of a case, a disc makes the wall sound: in the time clock four discs in the cover at the largest swing.
A square wave is heard at 220 and 440 Hz, where a sine is not: its harmonics reach the resonance of the disc.

ways.by: the bench of ~/freecad/tc-eth-poe/piezo-test, four 27 mm discs on an ESP32
